arguments.text: 8000 m, 8 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Settle after the hard start to about critical power plus a little: boat ~112-115 W / pod shaft ~160-165 W, so both reserves reach near zero only in the last 800 m. Hold that through the middle legs; compare same-direction legs to separate current from fatigue. Final push from ~800 m to go with whatever reserve is left. Watch for anything that slows the boat at the same effort (rudder weed, drag, current) and for pod vs boat disagreement (instrument drift). Answer radio messages and paddler talk promptly.

arguments.message: Pod reserve below 35 % with more than 2 km to go: paddler is overspending.
GPS speed well below what pod power should give: check for weed on the rudder, extra drag, adverse current or wind.

arguments.reason: See where the paddler settles after the start.

text: no cue: start is still settling; plan set, watches on pod reserve and on boat slowing at the same effort, wake-ups at 168 s and 900 m to go.

arguments.text: Good start. Settle now into long smooth race pace.

2.8 min: still well above CP after start (boat 133 W vs 110, pod 182 vs 158), reserves boat 64 %, pod 70 %. Cued ease (no pace target, because push of current flips on the return legs). Leg 1 (north) has a helping push ~+0.15 m/s. Check at ~4.5 min that power came down to ~112-118 W boat / 160-168 W pod.

arguments.reason: Check the ease cue took effect.

text: Cued ease: still 20 % above critical power three minutes in, reserves draining fast.

arguments.text: A touch easier still. Smooth through the turn.

arguments.reason: Check power after the first turn; compare leg 2 with leg 1.

text: Cued ease again: pod 172 W vs sustainable 162 W, reserve would empty in about 2.2 km.

arguments.text: Ease off now, breathe, long strokes. Plenty of race left.

6.2 min (leg 2, south, push about -0.05 to -0.1 m/s): paddler said cooked, cannot hold this; asked: effort 7/10, really hurting. Pod still 173 W vs sustainable 162 W after two ease cues (second had little effect); pod reserve 51 %, boat 42 %. Cued ease a third time. If pod stays above ~165 W or paddler keeps saying cooked, CP may be lower than the test said (test can be 10-25 % off); consider lowering cp_shaft.

arguments.reason: Check whether the third ease cue lowered pod power.

text: Cued ease with reassurance: paddler hurting at 7/10 and pod power still above sustainable.
no cue: last ease cue only 18 s old; next check already set for 454 s.

arguments.message: Pod power held more than 9 W above sustainable for a minute.
Pod power more than 10 W below sustainable for a minute: paddler may be backing off too much or blowing up.
Boat-model power and pod power disagree (ratio outside 0.6-0.8; it was 0.70): drag, current, or instrument drift.

arguments.reason: Routine check after the second turn: compare leg 3 with leg 1.

text: no cue: pod power down to 167 W, near sustainable 162 W and still falling; added watches for over/under-spending and boat-vs-pod disagreement.

arguments.text: 10.6 min, start of leg 3 (north): legs so far: leg 1 out pod 178 W, GPS 3.31, push +0.18; leg 2 back pod 170 W, GPS 3.03, push -0.07. Pod still ~170 W vs sustainable 161 W; pod reserve 35 %, boat 23 %, fade -2 %. Ease cues only take off ~5 W and fade. Next: once leg 3 push is known, cue ease WITH a ground pace target for this leg (sustainable water speed ~3.04 m/s plus the leg push).

arguments.reason: Read the leg 3 push and cue ease with a pace target.

text: no cue: just turned onto leg 3; waiting a minute to read this leg push before giving a paced ease cue.

arguments.text: Reserve is low. Back off a little, hold 2:45 pace.

arguments.message: Leg 3 (north) is not getting the +0.18 m/s push leg 1 had: current changed, or something is dragging the boat.

text: Cued ease to 2:45 pace: pod reserve 34 % with 6 km to go, pod 170 W vs sustainable 161 W.

arguments.text: 8000 m, 8 legs of 1000 m out-and-back (odd legs north, current helps ~+0.1 to +0.18 m/s; even legs south, ~-0.07). Pace by the POD (effort): hold shaft power at sustainable_shaft_power_w (~160 W now); boat-model reserve reads lower than the pod (it folds current into power), so trust the pod. Ease cues alone barely work; ease/hold WITH a ground pace target worked (11 min). Ground pace for ~160 W pod: north legs ~2:37-2:40, south legs ~2:45-2:47. Final push from ~800 m to go with whatever pod reserve is left. Watch for anything that slows the boat at the same effort and for pod vs boat disagreement. Answer radio and paddler talk promptly.

text: no cue: pod power now 160 W, right at sustainable; plan updated to pace by the pod with leg-specific ground paces.

arguments.text: That is the right effort. Hold 2:39 on this leg.
That is the right effort. Hold 2:39 on this leg.

arguments.reason: Just after the turn onto leg 4 (south, adverse push): give a hold cue with the south-leg ground pace (~2:46) so pod stays ~160 W.

text: Cued hold at 2:39: pod dipped to 156 W chasing the 2:45 target on a helped leg; set a wake-up after the next turn for the south-leg pace.

arguments.text: Probably weed on the rudder. One back-stroke to clear it.

13.4 min, leg 3 north, 2.5 km: push_local fell from +0.13 (724 s) to +0.03 (800 s) at steady pod ~157 W; fade -4.6 %; eta_est steady 0.70 (slow estimate). Paddler: effort 8/10, boat feels heavy, like something is dragging. Cued clear_rudder at 13.4 min. Check: did speed dip (back-stroke done) and does push_local recover to ~+0.12 on this leg? If not, the drag is something else (water in hull, damaged blade, current change): compare leg 4 with leg 2 (south, -0.07).

arguments.reason: Check whether clearing the rudder brought the speed back.

text: Cued clear_rudder: speed at the same pod power fell 0.1 m/s in a minute and the paddler says something is dragging.

arguments.text: Rudder clear, speed is back. Settle again, do not chase.

14.7 min: clear_rudder worked: back-stroke seen (speed dip 37 %), push_local back to +0.11 and fade back to +0.9 %. It was weed or debris on the rudder; if push_local falls again at steady pod power with no turn, clear again. After the back-stroke the paddler surged to pod 173 W; pod reserve 25 % with 5.2 km left; cued ease.

arguments.message: Speed at the same stroke rate down more than 3.5 % vs early race: possible weed on the rudder again (compare push_local and paddler feel).

text: Cued ease: rudder cleared and speed recovered, but the paddler surged to 173 W pod with only 25 % reserve left.

arguments.reason: Race committee radio at 14.9 min: course shortened by one leg, finish now at 7000 m.
Tell the paddler the course is shortened: finish at 7000 m (cue tell with distance_left_m).
On leg 4 (south, adverse push): check pod vs the new sustainable power and give a hold cue with a ground pace.
Plan the final push (finish at 7000 m).

arguments.text: Course SHORTENED by radio at 14.9 min: finish at 7000 m (7 legs of 1000 m; race distance set to 7000). Odd legs north, current helps ~+0.1 to +0.18 m/s; even legs south ~-0.07. Pace by the POD: hold shaft power at sustainable_shaft_power_w (recomputed for 7000 m). Boat-model reserve reads lower than the pod; trust the pod. Ease cues alone barely work; ease/hold WITH a ground pace target works. Weed on the rudder happened at 13 min (cleared by back-stroke): if speed falls at steady pod power, clear again. Final push from ~800 m to go with the pod reserve left.

text: Radio: course shortened to 7000 m; set race distance, rewrote plan, wake-up in 50 s to tell the paddler (cue gap not yet open).
no cue: ease cue only 10 s old and the cue gap is closed for 40 s; wake-up already set to tell the new distance.

arguments.text: 15.5 min, 2.93 km (finish now 7000 m, 4.07 km left): paddler says this hurts, cannot keep this up. Pod ROSE to 182 W after the ease cue (sustainable 160 W); pod reserve 19 %, empties in 430 m. ORDER: first an ease cue WITH a ground pace for leg 4 south (~2:48, 168 s), then 60 s later the tell cue with distance_left_m for the 7000 m finish. push_local dipped to 0.00 near the turn at 3000 m; if it stays low on leg 4 (expected -0.07), suspect weed again.
Ease now. Easy 2:48 into this leg, recover.
Ease now. Easy 2:48 into this leg, recover.

text: no cue yet (gap 2 s short): next wake-up gives the paced ease cue to 2:48, then the 7000 m finish tell.

arguments.text: Too hot. Ease to 2:48 on this leg and recover.

arguments.reason: Tell the paddler the finish is now at 7000 m (tell with distance_left_m), and check the ease took effect.

text: Cued ease to 2:48: pod 186 W vs sustainable 160 W, pod reserve 15 %; tell about the 7000 m finish in 62 s.

arguments.text: Weed again. One back-stroke to clear, then ease off.

16.9 min, leg 4 south, 3.16 km: push_local fell again on leg 3 from +0.13 (866 s) to 0.00 (940 s) at rising pod power (same shape as the first weed), then -0.26 on leg 4 (expected -0.07). Pod 187 W, pod reserve 7 %, boat ratio 0.57 (alert). Paddler 9/10, hurting, did not mention drag this time. The 2:48 pace target made the paddler push harder against the drag. Cued clear_rudder at 16.9 min. NEXT (about 17.9 min): if speed recovered, cue ease with no pace target or a hold; then tell the 7000 m finish. If speed did NOT recover, suspect pod drift reading high (check boat-model power vs pod).

text: Cued clear_rudder: speed fell 0.13-0.19 m/s below the same effort, the same pattern as the first weed; ease and the 7000 m tell come next.

arguments.reason: Check whether the second clear_rudder brought speed back; then cue ease (or handle pod drift) and tell the 7000 m finish.
Plan the final push (finish at 7000 m).
